records.name: boot_hook_reference
records.command: strings /usr/sbin/tdsmgr | grep -F 'sys.init_after.sh'; strings /usr/sbin/utils | grep -E '(/data|mtdblock7|log.*(clear|erase)|jffs2)' | grep -v -E '/data[0-9]+/|password|PRIVATE' | head -n 30
records.output:
-Call sys.init_after.sh to start other process!
sh /usr/syscfg/sys.init_after.sh
mount -t jffs2 /dev/mtdblock7 /data
*.emerg          /data/log/emerg.txt
*.alert          /data/log/alert.txt
*.crit           /data/log/crit.txt
*.err            /data/log/err.txt
*.warning        /data/log/warning.txt
*.notice         /data/log/notice.txt
*.info           /data/log/info.txt
*.debug          /data/log/debug.txt
/data/log

records.name: model_build
records.command: printf 'software='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.DeviceInfo.SoftwareVersion; printf '\nhardware='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.DeviceInfo.HardwareVersion; printf '\n'
